description: Ministry of Home Affairs  -   Establishment   of New Divisional Secretary's Divisions in Nuwara-Eliya, Gall and Rathnapura District
categorisation: This gazette contains both a named individual (Wajira Abeywardana, Minister of Internal & Home Affairs and Provincial Councils & Local Government) AND detailed descriptions of the administrative responsibilities being assigned (establishing new Divisional Secretary's Divisions in specific districts, revising existing divisions, and specifying their composition and boundaries). This combination of a specific person and detailed administrative responsibilities makes it a Hybrid Gazette (Type 3).
